/* Lobby */
.lobby{height:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:141px minmax(0,1fr) 197px;gap:8px;padding:8px 9px}.sidestack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-height:0;overflow:auto}.sideaction{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-align:left;padding:9px 7px;height:calc((100% - 35px)/6);min-height:35px;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#21161dce,#130d16a0);border:1px solid rgba(211,146,94,.23);border-radius:6px;font-size:11px}.sideaction b{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:20px;color:#d7ab71;font-weight:400;width:25px;text-align:center}.hero-stage{position:relative;min-width:0;border:1px solid #885947;border-radius:11px;overflow:hidden;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(10,7,17,.94) 0%,rgba(10,7,17,.48) 42%,rgba(10,7,17,.12) 70%,rgba(10,7,17,.65) 100%),url('data:image/webp;base64,');background-size:cover;background-position:70% 37%;box-shadow:inset 0 0 70px #050309,0 0 38px #150710a9}.hero-stage:before{content:"";inset:0;position:absolute;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#0a0815e8,transparent 43%)}.hero-info{position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:11px;right:11px;text-shadow:0 2px 8px #000}.hero-info h1{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-weight:400;margin:2px 0;font-size:34px;color:#fff1d8}.hero-info h1 span{font-size:21px;color:#ff8185;font-style:italic}.hero-info p{font-size:11px;margin:3px 0 8px;color:#dfc1b9}.herobuttons{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.statpills{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px}.pill{font-size:9px;background:#21131ddc;border:1px solid #654551;border-radius:30px;padding:4px 7px}.promo{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;overflow:auto}.promocard{flex:1;min-height:0;text-align:left;padding:10px;background:linear-gradient(110deg,rgba(12,8,16,.87),rgba(59,30,44,.65)),url('data:image/webp;base64,') center/cover;border:1px solid #95724f;border-radius:7px;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:17px;color:#f3d8b1;line-height:1.1}.promocard small{font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui;font-size:9px;display:block;margin-top:5px;color:#cbb1a8}.promocard:nth-child(2){background-image:linear-gradient(110deg,#130b14e8,#6b293b55),url('data:image/webp;base64,')}.promocard:nth-child(3){background-image:linear-gradient(110deg,#1c1217c9,#34242988),url('data:image/webp;base64,')}
/* Rosters */
.herocard{padding:8px;min-width:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.herocard:before{content:"";position:absolute;right:-22px;top:-24px;width:105px;height:105px;border-radius:100%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#69334e66,transparent 70%);pointer-events:none}.portrait{height:71px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #85664c;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 22%,#795e62,#352630 45%,#0c0b13 89%);margin-bottom:6px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.portrait img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:55% 27%}.portrait .sigil{font:39px Georgia,serif;color:#f4d6a2;text-shadow:0 0 12px #df5369}.rarity{position:absolute;right:5px;top:5px;padding:2px 5px;border-radius:4px;background:#09070eca;font-size:9px;border:1px solid #725752;font-weight:800}.rarity.c{color:#aeb0bc}.rarity.r{color:#82baff}.rarity.e{color:#c88fff}.rarity.l{color:#ffcf6c}.rarity.s{color:#ff838e;border-color:#cf6b73}.herocard h3{font:16px Georgia,serif;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;overflow:hidden;margin:2px 0}.herocard p{font-size:10px;color:#c4b5b4;margin:3px 0}.herocard .smallactions{display:flex;gap:4px;margin-top:6px}.herocard .smallactions button{padding:5px 6px;font-size:9px;flex:1}.herocard.active{border-color:#dcbb81;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #c69352 inset}.herocard .portrait{height:79px}.statline{font-size:10px;color:#d8bbb1;display:flex;gap:8px}
/* Campaign */
.chaptergrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;margin-top:7px}.chapter{padding:9px 10px;min-height:86px;text-align:left;border:1px solid #7a5848;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#2b1c2bdc,#100d18e8);position:relative}.chapter.locked{opacity:.47}.chapter strong{display:block;font:17px Georgia,serif;color:#eec28a;margin:3px 0}.chapter small{font-size:9px;color:#c3b2a8}.chapter em{font:10px ui-sans-serif,system-ui;color:#9bd0b4;font-style:normal}
/* Shop + quest */
.shopitem{padding:10px;min-height:99px}.shopitem h3{font:17px Georgia,serif;color:#f4d6a4;margin:0 0 4px}.shopitem p{font-size:10px;color:#c4b6b4;margin:3px 0 7px}.shopitem button{font-size:10px;padding:7px 10px}.qrow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:9px;padding:8px 10px}.qrow h4{font-size:11px;margin:0 0 3px;font-weight:700}.qrow p{font-size:9px;color:#baa8ac;margin:0 0 5px}.bar{height:5px;background:#160d18;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #60434a}.bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#bd5168,#efb36d)}
/* Battle */
#battlebox{height:100%;position:relative;overflow:hidden}#battlecanvas{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;touch-action:none}.battle-title{position:absolute;left:12px;top:10px;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:19px;color:#ffe7c0;text-shadow:0 2px 5px #000}.battle-top{position:absolute;top:9px;right:10px;display:flex;gap:6px}.battle-hud{position:absolute;bottom:7px;left:7px;right:7px;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;pointer-events:none}.battle-heroes{display:flex;gap:5px}.battle-hero{pointer-events:auto;width:92px;height:60px;border:1px solid #bd8c5a;background:linear-gradient(#392330e9,#100a14ed);border-radius:7px;padding:5px;text-align:left;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.battle-hero b{font-size:10px;display:block}.battle-hero small{font-size:9px;color:#dec3af}.battle-hero .bar{margin-top:5px}.battle-hero.ready{box-shadow:0 0 13px #e99d67c8;border-color:#f3c78b;animation:pulse 1s infinite alternate}.battle-hero.dead{opacity:.4}.battle-info{font-size:10px;color:#d3c6be;background:#110c18c4;padding:6px;border-radius:6px;max-width:220px;text-align:right}@keyframes pulse{to{box-shadow:0 0 5px #c05e5688}}.battle-hint{position:absolute;top:46px;left:13px;font-size:10px;color:#c3a3a4}
/* Modal */
#modalRoot{position:fixed;z-index:10;inset:0;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:max(15px,env(safe-area-inset-top)) max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) max(15px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-left));background:#05040add;backdrop-filter:blur(7px)}#modalRoot.open{display:flex}.modal{width:min(610px,94vw);max-height:92vh;overflow:auto;border:1px solid #d1a575;background:linear-gradient(148deg,#33212a,#120c19 74%);box-shadow:0 30px 80px #000b,0 0 40px #611d3566;border-radius:12px;padding:15px;position:relative}.modal h2{font:27px Georgia,serif;margin:2px 0 7px;color:#f9d8ad}.modal p{font-size:12px;color:#d0bbba;line-height:1.5}.close{position:absolute;right:12px;top:9px;background:#1a101a;border:1px solid #6d5252;border-radius:50%;width:27px;height:27px}.modal .portrait{height:158px}.modal-two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:45% 1fr;gap:12px;align-items:start}.toast{position:fixed;z-index:30;bottom:78px;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,15px);max-width:min(500px,85vw);background:#211321f2;border:1px solid #d1a371;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 16px;color:#ffe3bd;font-size:12px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.2s;box-shadow:0 8px 35px #0009;text-align:center}.toast.show{transform:translate(-50%,0);opacity:1}#orientation{display:none}
@media(max-width:740px) and (orientation:landscape){.brand{min-width:123px}.brand strong{font-size:19px}.brand em{font-size:7px}.nameblock{min-width:92px}.currency{padding:0 5px}.lobby{grid-template-columns:103px minmax(0,1fr) 142px}.sideaction{gap:3px;padding:5px;font-size:9px}.hero-info h1{font-size:26px}.promocard{font-size:13px}.hero-info{left:8px}.title{font-size:23px}.chaptergrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}.navbutton{font-size:9px}}
@media(max-height:380px) and (orientation:landscape){#hud{height:42px}.screen{height:calc(100% - 99px)}.dock{height:57px}.lobby{padding:5px}.sideaction{min-height:29px}.hero-info h1{font-size:25px}.hero-info p{margin:2px 0 5px}.statpills{margin-bottom:3px}.herobuttons button{padding:6px}.battle-hero{height:52px}}
@media (orientation:portrait){#orientation{display:flex;position:fixed;z-index:100;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,#3f1c2c,#090711 75%);align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;padding:35px;text-align:center}#orientation b{font:33px Georgia,serif;color:#f0c897}#orientation p{line-height:1.6;color:#dfc6be;font-size:15px}#orientation span{font-size:60px;display:block;margin:16px}#orientation button{margin-top:10px}}

<body>
<div id="app"><header id="hud"></header><main id="scene" class="screen"></main><footer id="dock" class="dock"></footer></div>
<div id="modalRoot" aria-modal="true" role="dialog"></div><div id="toast" class="toast"></div>
<div id="orientation"><b>VEILFALL</b><span>↻</span><p>Rotate your iPhone sideways for the full-screen fantasy RPG experience.</p><button class="goldbutton" data-action="fullscreen">Enter game</button></div>
<script>
(()=>{'use strict';
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id), ASSET={face:'data:image/webp;base64,',hero:'data:image/webp;base64,',castle:'data:image/webp;base64,'};
const HEROES=[];
const add=(names,rarity,role,element,skill,desc,price=null)=>names.split('|').forEach((name,i)=>{const id='h'+(HEROES.length+1);HEROES.push({id,name,rarity,role:Array.isArray(role)?role[i%role.length]:role,element,skill:Array.isArray(skill)?skill[i%skill.length]:skill,desc,price:Array.isArray(price)?price[i]??null:price,adult:false});});
add('Morrow Footman|Dunewatch Militia|Frostline Guard|Cinder Scout|Ashwood Sentry|Stone Lantern|Vigil Archer|Rime Adept|Tomb Spearman|Iron Chapel Guard|Mist Hunter|Gravehand', 'C',['Vanguard','Ranger','Mage'],'Iron',['Shield Strike','Piercing Shot','Arcane Bolt'],'Reliable recruits from the shattered borderlands.');
add('Aelyn the Swift|Corvus Blackwing|Lyra Whiteflame|Darian Voss|Selene Mistwalker|Varek Talon|Oryn Hollow|Astra Reed|Kira Blackthorn|Mavren Warden','R',['Ranger','Assassin','Mage','Vanguard'],'Storm',['Storm Barrage','Shadow Cut','Aegis Break'],'Veteran warriors who bend the battle in your favor.');
add('Riven Ashblade|Maris Nightseer|Eryndel Frostborn|Vanta Umbral|Sir Garric Flint|Celestine Vale|Talia Redspire|Kael Wildfire|Veyrin of Glass|Isolde Veilkeeper','E',['Assassin','Mage','Vanguard','Support'],'Aether',['Crimson Tempest','Frozen Spiral','Bastion Oath','Moonlight Mend'],'Elite champions with devastating ultimate arts.');
add('Thorne, the Iron Saint|Miravel of Dawns|Azrak the Riftlord|Noctis Palehunter|Elaria Sunbane|Vesper Galeheart|Aurek Ironwraith|Sybelle of Embers','L',['Vanguard','Support','Mage','Assassin','Ranger'],'Eclipse',['Cataclysm Wall','Sanctuary Pulse','Void Collapse','Execution Waltz','Solar Spear'],'Legendary warriors with a unique battlefield ultimate.',[null,null,null,null,9.99,19.99,29.99,39.99]);
HEROES.push({id:'nyxara',name:'Nyxara',rarity:'S',role:'Vampire Empress',element:'Blood Moon',skill:'Crimson Eclipse',desc:'The Duskborn Empress. A colossal blood-moon blast strikes every foe while healing her entire party. An exclusive overpowered SSS hero.',price:49.99,adult:true});
const byId=id=>HEROES.find(h=>h.id===id),rarityName={C:'COMMON',R:'RARE',E:'EPIC',L:'LEGENDARY',S:'SSS'},rarityClass={C:'c',R:'r',E:'e',L:'l',S:'s'};
const fmt=n=>Math.floor(n).toLocaleString('en-US'),cost=n=>'$'+n.toFixed(2),day=()=>new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),month=()=>day().slice(0,7),week=()=>{const d=new Date(),u=new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(),d.getUTCMonth(),d.getUTCDate())),dd=u.getUTCDay()||7;u.setUTCDate(u.getUTCDate()+4-dd);return u.getUTCFullYear()+'-W'+String(Math.ceil((((u-new Date(Date.UTC(u.getUTCFullYear(),0,1)))/86400000)+1)/7)).padStart(2,'0')};
const fresh=()=>({owner:true,adultConfirmed:false,gold:42500,gems:950,energy:180,stage:1,level:6,arenaRank:9000,owned:['h1','h4','h14','h24'],party:['h1','h14','h24','h4'],levels:{h1:3,h14:3,h24:2,h4:2},passes:{weekly:0,monthly:0},questClaims:{},counters:{daily:{stamp:day(),wins:0,arena:0,boss:0,guild:0,summons:0,training:0},weekly:{stamp:week(),wins:0,arena:0,boss:0,guild:0,summons:0,training:0},monthly:{stamp:month(),wins:0,arena:0,boss:0,guild:0,summons:0,training:0}},freeSummonDay:'',pity:0,inventory:{swords:0,armor:0,relics:0},guild:'Cinder Oath',stats:{wins:0,arena:0,boss:0,guild:0,summons:0,training:0},setting:{music:false}});
let state=fresh();try{const loaded=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('veilfall-save-v2')||'null');if(loaded&&typeof loaded==='object'){state={...state,...loaded,passes:{...state.passes,...loaded.passes},inventory:{...state.inventory,...loaded.inventory},stats:{...state.stats,...loaded.stats}};}}catch(e){}
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem('veilfall-save-v2',JSON.stringify(state))}catch(e){}};
const checkCounters=()=>{for(const [period,stamp] of [['daily',day()],['weekly',week()],['monthly',month()]]){if(!state.counters?.[period]||state.counters[period].stamp!==stamp){state.counters??={};state.counters[period]={stamp,wins:0,arena:0,boss:0,guild:0,summons:0,training:0};}}};checkCounters();
const inc=k=>{checkCounters();state.stats[k]=(state.stats[k]||0)+1;for(const per of ['daily','weekly','monthly'])state.counters[per][k]=(state.counters[per][k]||0)+1};
const access=()=>state.owner||state.passes.monthly>Date.now()||state.passes.weekly>Date.now();
const mult=()=>state.owner||state.passes.monthly>Date.now()?1.5:state.passes.weekly>Date.now()?1.2:1;
const heroLevel=h=>(state.levels[h.id]||1);
const stats=h=>{const base={C:[195,21],R:[260,30],E:[360,44],L:[565,72],S:[1250,180]}[h.rarity],lv=heroLevel(h),role=h.role;return{hp:Math.round(base[0]*(1+(lv-1)*.13)+(role==='Vanguard'?55:0)),atk:Math.round(base[1]*(1+(lv-1)*.11)+(role==='Assassin'?4:0)+(state.inventory.swords||0)*2),spd:role==='Assassin'?1.38:role==='Ranger'?1.22:role==='Support'?1.12:1}};
let tab='home',battle=null,stageTarget=state.stage,modalKind='',pendingHero=null,toastTimer=0,raf=0;
const toast=(msg)=>{const el=$('toast');el.textContent=msg;el.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('show'),2600)};
const hCard=(h)=>{const owned=state.owned.includes(h.id),chosen=state.party.includes(h.id);return `<div class="card herocard ${chosen?'active':''}"><div class="portrait">${h.id==='nyxara'?`<img src="${ASSET.face}" alt="Original vampire queen art">`:`<span class="sigil">${({C:'♟',R:'♞',E:'✦',L:'♛',S:'✧'})[h.rarity]}</span>`}<span class="rarity ${rarityClass[h.rarity]}">${rarityName[h.rarity]}</span></div><h3>${h.name}</h3><p>${h.role} · Lv.${heroLevel(h)}</p><div class="statline"><span>⚔ ${stats(h).atk}</span><span>♥ ${stats(h).hp}</span></div><div class="smallactions"><button class="ghostbutton" data-action="preview" data-id="${h.id}">Preview</button>${owned?`<button class="${chosen?'softbutton':'goldbutton'}" data-action="party" data-id="${h.id}">${chosen?'Remove':'Deploy'}</button>`:`<button class="goldbutton" data-action="getHero" data-id="${h.id}">${h.price?'$'+h.price.toFixed(2):'Summon'}</button>`}</div></div>`};
function renderHUD(){$('hud').innerHTML=`<div class="brand"><strong>VEILFALL</strong><em>CROWN OF CINDERS</em></div><div class="nameblock"><span class="crest">♛</span><span>Veil Sovereign<small>Lv.${state.level} · ${state.owner?'OWNER ACCESS':'Wanderer'}</small></span></div><span class="tag">${state.owner?'OWNER':'VIP 0'}</span><div class="currencybar"><button class="currency" data-action="shop">💎 <span class="blue">${state.owner?'∞':fmt(state.gems)}</span> +</button><button class="currency" data-action="shop">◉ <b>${state.owner?'∞':fmt(state.gold)}</b> +</button><span class="currency">⚡ ${fmt(state.energy)}/240</span></div><button class="hudbutton" data-action="settings">⚙</button>`}
const nav=[['home','⌂','Hall'],['campaign','♜','Story'],['heroes','♛','Heroes'],['arena','⚔','Arena'],['guild','✥','Guild'],['boss','♞','Boss'],['quests','☷','Quests'],['passes','✧','Passes'],['shop','◇','Shop']];
function renderDock(){$('dock').innerHTML=nav.map(([t,ico,label])=>`<button class="navbutton ${tab===t?'active':''}" data-action="tab" data-id="${t}"><span class="navicon">${ico}</span>${label}</button>`).join('')}
function renderHome(){return `<div class="lobby"><div class="sidestack"><button class="sideaction" data-action="tab" data-id="quests"><b>☷</b> Daily missions</button><button class="sideaction" data-action="tab" data-id="campaign"><b>♜</b> Story chapters</button><button class="sideaction" data-action="tab" data-id="passes"><b>✧</b> Weekly pass</button><button class="sideaction" data-action="tab" data-id="passes"><b>♛</b> Monthly pass</button><button class="sideaction" data-action="tab" data-id="shop"><b>◇</b> Crystal bazaar</button><button class="sideaction" data-action="tab" data-id="heroes"><b>⚔</b> Champion roster</button></div><section class="hero-stage"><div class="hero-info"><span class="eyebrow">Limited · Adult access · SSS hero</span><h1>Nyxara <span>SSS</span></h1><p>The Duskborn Empress · Vampire Queen</p><div class="statpills"><span class="pill">⚔ Arcane / AoE</span><span class="pill">♥ Life Drain</span><span class="pill">✧ Party Heal</span><span class="pill">☾ Blood Moon</span></div><div class="herobuttons"><button class="goldbutton" data-action="getHero" data-id="nyxara">${state.owned.includes('nyxara')?'OWNED':state.owner?'OWNER: FREE':'$49.99'}</button><button class="softbutton" data-action="preview" data-id="nyxara">▶ Hero Preview</button><button class="ghostbutton" data-action="tab" data-id="campaign">Chapter ${Math.ceil(state.stage/5)} ▸</button></div></div></section><div class="promo"><button class="promocard" data-action="tab" data-id="campaign">The Ashbound Road <small>100 stages · 20 chapters</small></button><button class="promocard" data-action="tab" data-id="heroes">Legendary Champions <small>Skills, previews and team building</small></button><button class="promocard" data-action="tab" data-id="passes">Crown Privileges <small>Auto battle · Extra rewards</small></button><button class="promocard" data-action="tab" data-id="boss">World Devourer <small>Defeat the siege boss</small></button></div></div>`}
const chName=['The Waking Ash','The Silent Causeway','Citadel of Knives','A Crown of Thorns','Frost over Veyra','The Weeping Spire','Sundering of Oaths','The Molten Archive','The Drowned Choir','A Thousand Lanterns','The Dragonless Sky','Bastion of Glass','Night of Three Kings','The Pale Labyrinth','Ashes of the Oracle','The Hollow Monarch','The Moonlit Siege','Blood in the Vault','Dominion of Cinders','The Eclipse Throne'];
function renderCampaign(){const current=Math.min(100,Math.max(1,stageTarget));return `<div class="panel"><div class="panelhead"><div><span class="eyebrow">Story Campaign · 20 original chapters</span><h2 class="title">The Ashbound Road</h2></div><div class="row"><span class="tag">Unlocked: Stage ${state.stage}/100</span><button class="goldbutton" data-action="battle" data-id="campaign">▶ Play stage ${current}</button></div></div><p class="muted tiny">Five battles per chapter. Win to unlock the next stage; earn gold, gems and hero upgrades.</p><div class="chaptergrid">${chName.map((name,i)=>{const first=i*5+1,unlocked=first<=state.stage;return `<button class="chapter ${unlocked?'':'locked'}" ${!unlocked?'disabled':''} data-action="chooseChapter" data-id="${first}"><small>CHAPTER ${i+1}</small><strong>${name}</strong><small>${unlocked?`Stages ${first}–${first+4}`:'🔒 Locked'}</small>${unlocked?`<br><em>Tap to choose</em>`:''}</button>`}).join('')}</div></div>`}
function renderHeroes(){const order={S:0,L:1,E:2,R:3,C:4};let sorted=[...HEROES].sort((a,b)=>(state.owned.includes(b.id)?1:0)-(state.owned.includes(a.id)?1:0)||order[a.rarity]-order[b.rarity]);return `<div class="panel"><div class="panelhead"><div><span class="eyebrow">Recruit · Train · Build Your Squad</span><h2 class="title">Hall of Champions</h2></div><div class="row"><span class="tag">${state.owned.length}/${HEROES.length} recruited</span><span class="tag">Squad ${state.party.length}/4</span><button class="goldbutton" data-action="summon">✦ Summon</button></div></div><p class="muted tiny">All Legendary heroes have a playable ultimate preview. Deploy up to four; train owned heroes using earned gold.</p><div class="grid cols5">${sorted.map(hCard).join('')}</div></div>`}
function renderArena(){return `<div class="panel"><div class="panelhead"><div><span class="eyebrow">Asynchronous NPC Challenge · Prototype</span><h2 class="title">Arena of Shattered Crowns</h2></div><button class="goldbutton" data-action="battle" data-id="arena">⚔ Fight Arena Duel</button></div><div class="grid cols3"><div class="card shopitem"><h3>Bronze Ascent</h3><p>Your simulated rank</p><h2 class="gold serif">#${fmt(state.arenaRank)}</h2></div><div class="card shopitem"><h3>Fallen Challenger</h3><p>Recommended power ${fmt(350+state.stats.arena*100)}</p><span class="tag">PvE opponent</span></div><div class="card shopitem"><h3>Victory Rewards</h3><p>Gold, crystals, and quest progress</p><span class="tag">Auto battle with a pass</span></div></div><p class="notice">This prototype uses computer-controlled opponents. Real-time matchmaking and leaderboards require online servers.</p></div>`}
function renderGuild(){return `<div class="panel"><div class="panelhead"><div><span class="eyebrow">Guild Stronghold · Offline Prototype</span><h2 class="title">${state.guild}</h2></div><button class="goldbutton" data-action="battle" data-id="guild">⚔ Start Guild Skirmish</button></div><div class="grid cols3"><div class="card shopitem"><h3>Ember Banner</h3><p>War against NPC faction: The Ivory Reavers</p><span class="tag">Guild skirmishes ${state.stats.guild}</span></div><div class="card shopitem"><h3>Guild Vault</h3><p>Every victory earns additional coins and gems.</p><span class="tag">Practice rewards</span></div><div class="card shopitem"><h3>Future Guild Wars</h3><p>Invite friends, chat and fight together after an online backend is built.</p><span class="tag">Planned for full game</span></div></div></div>`}
function renderBoss(){return `<div class="panel"><div class="panelhead"><div><span class="eyebrow">Relentless World Enemy</span><h2 class="title">Vaelgor, the Cinder Devourer</h2></div><button class="goldbutton" data-action="battle" data-id="boss">⚔ Enter Boss Fight</button></div><div class="grid cols3"><div class="card shopitem"><h3>🔥 Siege of the Rift</h3><p>One colossal boss with a powerful strike. He grows stronger after every victory.</p></div><div class="card shopitem"><h3>💎 Boss Bounty</h3><p>300–600 gold, 35 gems, rare relic chance and quest rewards.</p></div><div class="card shopitem"><h3>☾ Record</h3><p>${state.stats.boss} bosses defeated. Bring support and a sturdy vanguard.</p></div></div></div>`}
const QUESTS={daily:[['wins',1,'Win one battle',30,170],['wins',3,'Win three battles',70,400],['summons',1,'Summon a hero',45,240],['training',1,'Train a champion',35,220],['arena',1,'Arena challenger',65,260],['boss',1,'Slay a world boss',80,500]],weekly:[['wins',9,'Win nine battles',180,1100],['arena',4,'Four arena victories',140,800],['boss',3,'Defeat three bosses',160,900],['summons',4,'Recruit four times',180,750],['training',5,'Train five times',120,700],['guild',3,'Three guild skirmishes',170,840]],monthly:[['wins',35,'Win 35 battles',600,3000],['arena',12,'Twelve arena wins',450,2700],['boss',10,'Ten bosses defeated',500,2800],['summons',15,'Summon 15 heroes',650,3500],['training',18,'Train 18 times',440,2300],['guild',12,'Twelve guild victories',520,2600]]};
function renderQuests(){checkCounters();return `<div class="panel"><div class="panelhead"><div><span class="eyebrow">Earn premium currency through play</span><h2 class="title">Royal Commission</h2></div><span class="tag">Daily · Weekly · Monthly</span></div><div class="grid cols3">${['daily','weekly','monthly'].map(per=>`<section class="stack"><div class="between"><b class="serif gold">${per[0].toUpperCase()+per.slice(1)} Quests</b><small class="muted">Resets ${per==='daily'?'each day':per==='weekly'?'weekly':'monthly'}</small></div>${QUESTS[per].map((q,i)=>{const [field,goal,label,gems,gold]=q,prog=state.counters[per][field]||0,claimKey=per+'-'+state.counters[per].stamp+'-'+i,claimed=state.questClaims[claimKey],canClaim=prog>=goal&&!claimed;return `<div class="card qrow"><div style="flex:1;min-width:0"><h4>${label}</h4><p>💎 ${gems} · ◉ ${gold} — ${Math.min(prog,goal)}/${goal}</p><div class="bar"><i style="width:${Math.min(100,prog/goal*100)}%"></i></div></div><button class="${canClaim?'goldbutton':'ghostbutton'} tiny" data-action="claim" data-id="${per}:${i}" ${canClaim?'':'disabled'}>${claimed?'Claimed':'Claim'}</button></div>`}).join('')}</section>`).join('')}</div></div>`}
const packs=[['Handful of Crystals',0.99,100,0],['Scout Supply',2.99,350,2500],['Crimson Cache',4.99,750,7000],['Royal Treasury',9.99,1700,18000],['Eclipse Hoard',24.99,4800,60000],['Empress Vault',49.99,11200,160000]];
function renderShop(){const premiums=HEROES.filter(h=>h.price);return `<div class="panel"><div class="panelhead"><div><span class="eyebrow">No payments are processed in this demonstration</span><h2 class="title">Obsidian Bazaar</h2></div><span class="tag">${state.owner?'Owner access: all items free':'Demo purchase mode'}</span></div><div class="notice">Prices are planned real-money prices in USD. Every purchase here is only simulated; no credit card, Apple payment or actual charge.</div><h3 class="serif gold" style="margin:10px 0 5px">Crystal & Gold Packs</h3><div class="grid cols3">${packs.map((p,i)=>`<div class="card shopitem"><h3>${p[0]}</h3><p>💎 ${fmt(p[2])} gems ${p[3]?` · ◉ ${fmt(p[3])} gold`:''}</p><button class="goldbutton" data-action="buyPack" data-id="${i}">${state.owner?'OWNER FREE':'Demo '+cost(p[1])}</button></div>`).join('')}</div><h3 class="serif gold" style="margin:11px 0 6px">Permanent Premium Champions</h3><div class="grid cols3">${premiums.map(h=>`<div class="card shopitem"><div class="between"><h3>${h.name}</h3><span class="rarity ${rarityClass[h.rarity]}" style="position:static">${rarityName[h.rarity]}</span></div><p>${h.skill} · ${h.role}${h.adult?' · 18+ access':''}</p><div class="row"><button class="ghostbutton" data-action="preview" data-id="${h.id}">▶ Preview</button><button class="goldbutton" data-action="getHero" data-id="${h.id}">${state.owned.includes(h.id)?'OWNED':state.owner?'OWNER FREE':cost(h.price)}</button></div></div>`).join('')}</div><h3 class="serif gold" style="margin:11px 0 6px">Armory · Earned Gold</h3><div class="grid cols3">${[['swords','Sharpened Armory','+2 squad attack per level',2500],['armor','Iron Guard','+2% party health per level',2400],['relics','Moon Relics','Powerful loot discovered from bosses',10000]].map(x=>`<div class="card shopitem"><h3>${x[1]} · Lv.${state.inventory[x[0]]||0}</h3><p>${x[2]}</p><button class="softbutton" data-action="buyGear" data-id="${x[0]}">◉ ${state.owner?'FREE':fmt(x[3])}</button></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`}
const passItems=[{id:'weekly',name:'Wanderer Weekly',price:3.99,duration:7,desc:['Full auto battle & skill casting','20% more combat rewards','Daily 80 gems','+20% energy recharge','Extra arena attempt in final game']},{id:'monthly',name:'Eclipse Crown Monthly',price:12.99,duration:30,desc:['Everything in Weekly Pass','50% more combat rewards','Daily 250 gems','2× battle speed & bonus boss loot','Exclusive monthly frame & title','Additional offline dispatch rewards']}];
function renderPasses(){return `<div class="panel"><div class="panelhead"><div><span class="eyebrow">Premium convenience · not required to finish story</span><h2 class="title">Crown Privileges</h2></div><span class="tag">Owner: ${state.owner?'unlimited access':'off'}</span></div><div class="grid cols3">${passItems.map(p=>`<div class="card shopitem" style="min-height:200px"><div class="between"><h3>${p.name}</h3><span class="tag">${p.duration} days</span></div>${p.desc.map(t=>`<p>✦ ${t}</p>`).join('')}<button class="goldbutton" data-action="buyPass" data-id="${p.id}">${state.owner?'OWNER FREE':`Demo ${cost(p.price)}`} ${state.passes[p.id]>Date.now()?'· ACTIVE':''}</button></div>`).join('')}<div class="card shopitem"><h3>Owner Privileges</h3><p>Developer accounts can receive every hero, upgrade, currency pack and pass for free.</p><p>In a public release this must be checked securely on the game server, not with a player-visible toggle.</p><button class="ghostbutton" data-action="settings">Owner Settings</button></div></div><p class="notice">Weekly and monthly passes are modeled as fixed-duration demo unlocks. Actual subscriptions and digital item sales on a native iPhone app require Apple In-App Purchase configuration.</p></div>`}
function renderSummon(){const free=state.freeSummonDay!==day(),total=state.stats.summons;return `<div class="panel"><div class="panelhead"><div><span class="eyebrow">Recruit fighters through play</span><h2 class="title">The Rift Summoning</h2></div><button class="goldbutton" data-action="summon">✧ ${free?'Free Daily Summon':'Summon · 💎100'}</button></div><div class="grid cols3"><div class="card shopitem"><h3>Common · 50%</h3><p>Base defenders, upgrade-friendly.</p></div><div class="card shopitem"><h3>Rare · 30%</h3><p>Experienced heroes.</p></div><div class="card shopitem"><h3>Epic · 16%</h3><p>Exceptional ultimate arts.</p></div><div class="card shopitem"><h3>Legendary · 4%</h3><p>Premium heroes excluded from random summon pool.</p></div><div class="card shopitem"><h3>Pity Guarantee</h3><p>Guaranteed a summonable Legendary by 25 non-legendary summons. Current: ${state.pity}/25.</p></div><div class="card shopitem"><h3>Your Record</h3><p>${total} total summons. Earn free gems from quests and battles.</p></div></div></div>`}
function renderInventory(){return `<div class="panel"><div class="panelhead"><div><span class="eyebrow">Upgrade your squad</span><h2 class="title">Relic Vault</h2></div><button class="goldbutton" data-action="tab" data-id="shop">Open Armory</button></div><div class="grid cols3">${[['swords','Armory Level','Squad attack'],['armor','Armor Level','Squad defense'],['relics','Blood Relics','Bonus relic damage']].map(v=>`<div class="card shopitem"><h3>${v[1]}: ${state.inventory[v[0]]||0}</h3><p>${v[2]}</p></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`}
function render(){renderHUD();renderDock();if(tab==='battle'){renderBattle();return}let inner={home:renderHome,campaign:renderCampaign,heroes:renderHeroes,arena:renderArena,guild:renderGuild,boss:renderBoss,quests:renderQuests,passes:renderPasses,shop:renderShop,summon:renderSummon,inventory:renderInventory}[tab];$('scene').innerHTML=(inner||renderHome)()}
function changeTab(t){if(battle){battle=null;cancelAnimationFrame(raf)}tab=t;render()}
function modal(html){modalKind='open';const el=$('modalRoot');el.innerHTML=`<div class="modal"><button class="close" data-action="close">×</button>${html}</div>`;el.classList.add('open')}
function close(){modalKind='';$('modalRoot').classList.remove('open')}
function preview(id){const h=byId(id);if(!h)return;const own=state.owned.includes(id),s=stats(h);modal(`<div class="modal-two"><div><div class="portrait">${id==='nyxara'?`<img src="${ASSET.hero}" alt="Nyxara vampire queen original artwork">`:`<span class="sigil" style="font-size:80px">${({C:'♟',R:'♞',E:'✦',L:'♛',S:'✧'})[h.rarity]}</span>`}</div><span class="tag">${rarityName[h.rarity]} · ${h.role}</span></div><div><span class="eyebrow">Playable Champion Preview</span><h2>${h.name}</h2><p><strong class="gold">Ultimate: ${h.skill}</strong></p><p>${h.desc}</p><p>Health <b>${s.hp}</b> · Attack <b>${s.atk}</b> · Level <b>${heroLevel(h)}</b></p><div class="row"><button class="goldbutton" data-action="tryHero" data-id="${id}">▶ Test Ultimate</button>${own?`<button class="softbutton" data-action="train" data-id="${id}">↑ Train</button>`:`<button class="softbutton" data-action="getHero" data-id="${id}">${h.price?state.owner?'OWNER FREE':cost(h.price):'Find in Summon'}</button>`}</div></div></div>${h.adult?'<p class="notice">18+ adult-only hero access. Artwork is non-explicit. Age confirmation is a prototype gate, not identity verification.</p>':''}`)}
function getHero(id){const h=byId(id);if(!h)return;if(state.owned.includes(id)){toast('Champion already in your roster');return}if(h.adult&&!state.adultConfirmed){pendingHero=id;modal(`<span class="eyebrow">Restricted Champion</span><h2>18+ Confirmation</h2><p>Nyxara is an adult-themed, non-explicit fantasy character. Access is intended only for players 18 or older.</p><p>This demo uses a self-declared age check. A released game would require appropriate platform ratings and, where required, reliable age assurance.</p><div class="row"><button class="goldbutton" data-action="confirmAdult">I confirm I am 18 or older</button><button class="ghostbutton" data-action="close">I am under 18</button></div>`);return}if(!h.price){toast('Earn this champion through the Rift Summon pool');changeTab('summon');return}state.owned.push(id);state.levels[id]=1;save();close();render();toast(state.owner?`${h.name} unlocked free with Owner Access`:`${h.name} unlocked — simulated ${cost(h.price)} purchase only`)}
function summon(){const isFree=state.freeSummonDay!==day();if(!isFree&&!state.owner&&state.gems<100){toast('Not enough gems — complete quests for more');return}if(!isFree&&!state.owner)state.gems-=100;if(isFree)state.freeSummonDay=day();let rarity;state.pity++;if(state.pity>=25)rarity='L';else{const r=Math.random()*100;rarity=r<50?'C':r<80?'R':r<96?'E':'L'}if(rarity==='L')state.pity=0;const pool=HEROES.filter(h=>h.rarity===rarity&&!h.price),h=pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];const already=state.owned.includes(h.id);if(!already){state.owned.push(h.id);state.levels[h.id]=1}else state.gold+=300;inc('summons');save();render();modal(`<span class="eyebrow">Rift Summoning</span><h2>${already?'Duplicate Echo':'New Champion!'}</h2><div class="portrait" style="height:100px"><span class="sigil" style="font-size:69px">${rarity==='L'?'♛':rarity==='E'?'✦':'♞'}</span></div><h2 class="gold">${h.name} · ${rarityName[h.rarity]}</h2><p>${already?'Converted duplicate into 300 gold.':'Added to your champion roster.'}</p><div class="row"><button class="goldbutton" data-action="close">Continue</button><button class="softbutton" data-action="tab" data-id="heroes">Hero Roster</button></div>`)}
function buyPass(id){const p=passItems.find(p=>p.id===id);if(!p)return;state.passes[id]=Math.max(Date.now(),state.passes[id]||0)+p.duration*86400000;if(id==='monthly')state.gems+=250;else state.gems+=80;save();render();toast(state.owner?`${p.name} granted for free (owner)`:`Demo activated ${p.name}; no money charged`)}
function buyPack(i){const p=packs[i];if(!p)return;state.gems+=p[2];state.gold+=p[3];save();render();toast(state.owner?'Owner received free currency pack':'Pack delivered in demo; no real payment occurred')}
function buyGear(id){const prices={swords:2500,armor:2400,relics:10000};if(!prices[id])return;if(!state.owner&&state.gold<prices[id]){toast('Not enough gold');return}if(!state.owner)state.gold-=prices[id];state.inventory[id]=(state.inventory[id]||0)+1;save();render();toast(`${id} upgraded`)}
function train(id){if(!state.owned.includes(id)){toast('Recruit the champion first');return}const lv=state.levels[id]||1,c=100*lv;if(lv>=80){toast('Maximum level reached');return}if(!state.owner&&state.gold<c){toast(`Training requires ${fmt(c)} gold`);return}if(!state.owner)state.gold-=c;state.levels[id]=lv+1;inc('training');save();render();if(modalKind)preview(id);toast(`${byId(id).name} reached level ${lv+1}`)}
function party(id){if(!state.owned.includes(id))return;const pos=state.party.indexOf(id);if(pos>=0)state.party.splice(pos,1);else if(state.party.length>=4){toast('Only four champions can be deployed');return}else state.party.push(id);save();render();toast(pos>=0?'Champion removed from team':'Champion added to team')}
function questsClaim(id){const [per,s]=id.split(':'),q=QUESTS[per]?.[Number(s)];if(!q)return;checkCounters();const key=per+'-'+state.counters[per].stamp+'-'+s;if(state.questClaims[key])return;if(state.counters[per][q[0]]<q[1])return;state.questClaims[key]=true;state.gems+=q[3];state.gold+=q[4];save();render();toast(`Claimed 💎${q[3]} and ◉${q[4]}`)}
function chooseChapter(first){stageTarget=Math.max(first,Math.min(state.stage,first+4));render();toast(`Chapter ${Math.ceil(first/5)} · Stage ${stageTarget} selected`)}
function battleParty(id){return (id?[id]:state.party).map(k=>byId(k)).filter(Boolean)}
function beginBattle(mode,previewId){if(!previewId&&state.party.length===0){toast('Deploy at least one champion');changeTab('heroes');return}close();battle={mode,previewId,units:[],fx:[],elapsed:0,done:false,speed:1,auto:access(),targetStage:stageTarget||state.stage,log:'Tap a glowing hero to cast their ultimate',started:performance.now()};const heroes=battleParty(previewId);const n=heroes.length;heroes.forEach((h,i)=>{const s=stats(h),bonusArmor=1+(state.inventory.armor||0)*.02;battle.units.push({id:h.id,name:h.name,h,side:'ally',x:.19+(i%2)*.075,y:.36+(i/Math.max(1,n-1))*.39,maxHp:s.hp*bonusArmor,hp:s.hp*bonusArmor,atk:s.atk,energy:previewId?100:28,cd:Math.random()*.5,spd:s.spd,flash:0,ult:0})});let enemyCount=mode==='boss'?1:mode==='preview'?3:mode==='guild'?4:mode==='arena'?4:Math.min(5,2+Math.ceil(battle.targetStage/12));const factor=mode==='campaign'?1+Math.max(0,battle.targetStage-1)*.12:mode==='boss'?1.45+state.stats.boss*.16:mode==='guild'?1.15+state.stats.guild*.09:mode==='arena'?1.2+state.stats.arena*.09:1;for(let i=0;i<enemyCount;i++){const boss=mode==='boss',hp=(boss?1700:mode==='preview'?200:270)*factor;const atk=(boss?36:mode==='preview'?12:16)*factor;battle.units.push({id:'enemy'+i,name:boss?'Vaelgor':'Ash Warden',side:'enemy',x:boss?.74:.7+(i%2)*.10,y:boss?.48:.35+i/(Math.max(1,enemyCount-1))*.38,maxHp:hp,hp,atk,energy:0,cd:1+i*.12,spd:1,flash:0,ult:0})}tab='battle';render();last=performance.now();cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
let canvas=null,ctx=null,last=0,castleImg=new Image();castleImg.src=ASSET.castle;
function renderBattle(){if(!battle){tab='home';render();return}$('scene').innerHTML=`<div id="battlebox"><canvas id="battlecanvas" aria-label="Real-time RPG combat"></canvas><div class="battle-title">${battle.mode==='campaign'?`CHAPTER ${Math.ceil(battle.targetStage/5)} · STAGE ${battle.targetStage}`:battle.mode==='preview'?'HERO TRAINING GROUNDS':battle.mode==='boss'?'WORLD BOSS · VAELGOR':battle.mode==='arena'?'THE SHATTERED ARENA':'GUILD SKIRMISH'}</div><div class="battle-hint">Automatic basic attacks · Tap lit portraits to use skills</div><div class="battle-top"><button class="softbutton tiny" data-action="battleAuto">AUTO ${battle.auto?'ON':'OFF'}</button><button class="ghostbutton tiny" data-action="speed">×${battle.speed}</button><button class="ghostbutton tiny" data-action="retreat">Leave</button></div><div class="battle-hud"><div class="battle-heroes">${battle.units.filter(u=>u.side==='ally').map((u,i)=>`<button class="battle-hero" data-action="cast" data-id="${i}" id="skill-${i}"><b>${u.name}</b><small>${u.h?.skill||'Ultimate'}</small><div class="bar"><i id="meter-${i}" style="width:0%"></i></div></button>`).join('')}</div><div class="battle-info" id="battleLog">${battle.log}</div></div></div>`;canvas=$('battlecanvas');ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');resizeCanvas();updateBattleButtons()}
function resizeCanvas(){if(!canvas||!canvas.isConnected)return;const box=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(),d=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);canvas.width=Math.round(box.width*d);canvas.height=Math.round(box.height*d);ctx.setTransform(d,0,0,d,0,0)}
function effect(x,y,color,size=30){battle.fx.push({x,y,color,r:size,ttl:.6})}
function setLog(s){if(!battle)return;battle.log=s;const el=$('battleLog');if(el)el.textContent=s}
function cast(i,fromAuto=false){if(!battle||battle.done)return;const allies=battle.units.filter(u=>u.side==='ally'),u=allies[i];if(!u||u.hp<=0||u.energy<99)return;u.energy=0;u.ult=.6;const foes=battle.units.filter(t=>t.side==='enemy'&&t.hp>0),all=battle.units.filter(t=>t.side==='ally'&&t.hp>0);const bonus=u.h.rarity==='S'?4.4:u.h.rarity==='L'?2.6:u.h.rarity==='E'?1.9:1.4;let dmg=u.atk*bonus;if(u.h.role==='Support'){for(const a of all){a.hp=Math.min(a.maxHp,a.hp+u.atk*3.5);effect(a.x,a.y,'#77e4b2',37)}dmg=u.atk*.9;setLog(`${u.name} casts ${u.h.skill} — party healed`)}else if(u.h.role==='Vanguard'){for(const a of all)a.hp=Math.min(a.maxHp,a.hp+u.atk*.5);dmg*=1.1;setLog(`${u.name}: ${u.h.skill} — defensive blast`)}else setLog(`${u.name}: ${u.h.skill}!`);
if(u.id==='nyxara'){dmg=u.atk*5.3;for(const a of all){a.hp=Math.min(a.maxHp,a.hp+u.atk*4);effect(a.x,a.y,'#ee728c',62)}setLog('NYXARA: CRIMSON ECLIPSE! All enemies struck. Squad healed!')}
for(const f of foes){let dealt=dmg*(.80+Math.random()*.42);if(u.h.role==='Assassin')dealt*=1.3;f.hp=Math.max(0,f.hp-dealt);f.flash=.24;effect(f.x,f.y,u.id==='nyxara'?'#ff4b71':'#e7b56e',u.id==='nyxara'?78:42)}effect(u.x,u.y,'#f1bd7c',55);updateBattleButtons();}
function tick(dt){if(!battle||battle.done)return;const b=battle;for(const f of b.fx){f.ttl-=dt;f.r+=dt*40}b.fx=b.fx.filter(f=>f.ttl>0);for(const u of b.units){u.flash=Math.max(0,u.flash-dt);u.ult=Math.max(0,u.ult-dt);if(u.hp<=0)continue;u.cd-=dt;u.energy=Math.min(100,u.energy+dt*5);const targets=b.units.filter(e=>e.side!==u.side&&e.hp>0);if(!targets.length)continue;if(u.cd<=0){u.cd=(u.side==='ally'?1.35:1.65)/u.spd;const target=targets[Math.floor(Math.random()*targets.length)];const amount=u.atk*(.83+Math.random()*.36);target.hp=Math.max(0,target.hp-amount);target.flash=.13;u.energy=Math.min(100,u.energy+(u.side==='ally'?24:0));effect(target.x,target.y,u.side==='ally'?'#e7b76e':'#ff617b',10);}}
if(b.auto){b.units.filter(u=>u.side==='ally').forEach((u,i)=>{if(u.energy>=100)cast(i,true)})}
const aliveA=b.units.some(u=>u.side==='ally'&&u.hp>0),aliveE=b.units.some(u=>u.side==='enemy'&&u.hp>0);
if(!aliveA||!aliveE){b.done=true;setTimeout(()=>finishBattle(aliveA),650)}updateBattleButtons()}
function updateBattleButtons(){if(!battle)return;battle.units.filter(u=>u.side==='ally').forEach((u,i)=>{const el=$('skill-'+i),bar=$('meter-'+i);if(el){el.classList.toggle('ready',u.energy>=99&&u.hp>0);el.classList.toggle('dead',u.hp<=0)}if(bar)bar.style.width=Math.max(0,u.energy)+'%'})}
function drawBattle(){if(!battle||!ctx||!canvas)return;const w=canvas.clientWidth,h=canvas.clientHeight,c=ctx,t=battle.elapsed;ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);let bg=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,w,h);bg.addColorStop(0,'#10131f');bg.addColorStop(.52,'#432538');bg.addColorStop(1,'#170d19');c.fillStyle=bg;c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);if(castleImg.complete&&castleImg.naturalWidth){c.globalAlpha=.20;c.drawImage(castleImg,w*.22,-h*.25,w*.58,h*1.6);c.globalAlpha=1}c.fillStyle='#0e0a11c9';c.fillRect(0,h*.70,w,h*.30);c.strokeStyle='#8b536455';c.lineWidth=1;for(let i=0;i<14;i++){const y=h*(.36+i*.038);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,y);c.lineTo(w,y);c.stroke()}for(let i=0;i<13;i++){const x=i*w/12;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(w*.5+(x-w*.5)*.36,h*.29);c.lineTo(x,h);c.stroke()}const fog=c.createRadialGradient(w*.5,h*.35,10,w*.5,h*.55,w*.6);fog.addColorStop(0,'#9b425626');fog.addColorStop(1,'#00000000');c.fillStyle=fog;c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
for(let i=0;i<15;i++){const x=(i*83.7+t*(4+i%4))%w,y=h*(.20+((i*1.73)%5)*.12)+Math.sin(t+i)*5;c.fillStyle=i%3?'#facb8355':'#db547a65';c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,i%3?1.1:1.7,0,7);c.fill()}
for(const u of battle.units){const x=u.x*w,y=u.y*h,scale= u.side==='enemy'&&battle.mode==='boss'?1.6:1;const alive=u.hp>0;c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.scale(scale,scale);c.globalAlpha=alive?1:.23;const aura=c.createRadialGradient(0,0,4,0,0,38);const color=u.side==='ally'?'#e7ae68':'#d55777';aura.addColorStop(0,color+'66');aura.addColorStop(1,color+'00');c.fillStyle=aura;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,10,38,18,0,0,7);c.fill();c.fillStyle='#04030a88';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,27,25,8,0,0,7);c.fill();c.strokeStyle=u.side==='ally'?'#edc17f':'#d76d89';c.lineWidth=2;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,26,24,8,0,0,7);c.stroke();if(u.flash>0){c.shadowBlur=23;c.shadowColor='#ffffff'}
// Dark high-fantasy armor silhouettes. Fully modeled 3D characters require a future engine build.
c.fillStyle=u.side==='ally'?'#252c39':'#3c1d2b';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-16,16);c.lineTo(-12,-20);c.lineTo(12,-20);c.lineTo(19,16);c.closePath();c.fill();c.strokeStyle=u.side==='ally'?'#b89469':'#a45365';c.lineWidth=3;c.stroke();c.fillStyle='#1a141c';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,-30,12,15,0,0,7);c.fill();c.fillStyle=u.id==='nyxara'?'#e9e6e6':'#bb9d81';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,-31,8,10,0,0,7);c.fill();c.fillStyle=u.id==='nyxara'?'#ede0e9':'#14121a';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-10,-31);c.lineTo(-17,-45);c.lineTo(0,-42);c.lineTo(15,-48);c.lineTo(10,-31);c.closePath();c.fill();c.fillStyle=u.side==='ally'?'#d7a560':'#bb5972';c.fillRect(-2,-18,4,27);c.fillStyle='#100d18';c.fillRect(-12,7,9,22);c.fillRect(4,7,9,22);c.strokeStyle=u.side==='ally'?'#e7cb8a':'#c16a83';c.lineWidth=3;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(16,-11);c.lineTo(30,-26);c.stroke();if(u.ult>0){c.shadowBlur=25;c.shadowColor=color;c.strokeStyle=color;c.beginPath();c.arc(0,-10,29+Math.sin(t*20)*3,0,7);c.stroke()}c.shadowBlur=0;c.globalAlpha=1;
const width=46,pct=Math.max(0,u.hp/u.maxHp);c.fillStyle='#08060baa';c.fillRect(-width/2,-55,width,5);c.fillStyle=u.side==='ally'?'#86dba4':'#f17b83';c.fillRect(-width/2,-55,width*pct,5);c.fillStyle='#f8ecde';c.font='9px system-ui';c.textAlign='center';c.fillText(u.name.substring(0,16),0,-62);c.restore()}
for(const f of battle.fx){const alpha=Math.min(.8,f.ttl/.6);c.strokeStyle=f.color;c.globalAlpha=alpha;c.lineWidth=3;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(f.x*w,f.y*h,f.r,Math.max(5,f.r*.35),0,0,7);c.stroke();c.globalAlpha=1}}
function loop(now){if(!battle||tab!=='battle')return;let dt=Math.min(.05,(now-last)/1000)*battle.speed;last=now;battle.elapsed+=dt;tick(dt);drawBattle();raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
function finishBattle(won){if(!battle)return;const b=battle,mode=b.mode;if(mode==='preview'){modal(`<span class="eyebrow">Training complete</span><h2>${won?'Ultimate demonstration complete':'Training ended'}</h2><p>The preview was a playable combat test and used no stamina or currency.</p><button class="goldbutton" data-action="afterBattle">Return to the Hall</button>`);return}let g=0,gem=0;if(won){g=Math.round((mode==='boss'?700:mode==='guild'?390:mode==='arena'?360:260+b.targetStage*14)*mult());gem=Math.round((mode==='boss'?35:mode==='arena'?24:mode==='guild'?28:14)*mult());state.gold+=g;state.gems+=gem;inc('wins');if(mode==='arena'){inc('arena');state.arenaRank=Math.max(1,state.arenaRank-Math.floor(30+Math.random()*120))}if(mode==='guild')inc('guild');if(mode==='boss'){inc('boss');if(Math.random()<.25)state.inventory.relics++}if(mode==='campaign'&&b.targetStage>=state.stage){state.stage=Math.min(100,b.targetStage+1);stageTarget=state.stage;state.level=Math.max(state.level,5+Math.floor(state.stage/3))}}save();modal(`<span class="eyebrow">${won?'Victory':'Defeat'}</span><h2>${won?'THE ASHEN CROWN ENDURES':'YOUR SQUAD HAS FALLEN'}</h2><p>${won?'The enemy forces have been shattered. Claim your spoils and march onward.':'Train your heroes or summon allies, then try the battle again.'}</p>${won?`<div class="row"><span class="tag">◉ +${fmt(g)} gold</span><span class="tag">💎 +${gem} gems</span><span class="tag">Quest progress +1</span></div>`:''}<div class="row" style="margin-top:12px"><button class="goldbutton" data-action="afterBattle">Continue</button>${!won?'<button class="softbutton" data-action="tab" data-id="heroes">Train heroes</button>':''}</div>`)}
function settings(){modal(`<span class="eyebrow">Game Settings / Development Build</span><h2>Owner Control Room</h2><p>In this local prototype, Owner Access is <b class="gold">${state.owner?'ON':'OFF'}</b>. Owner Access gives unlimited battle auto, all passes, free heroes, upgrades, gems and gold.</p><div class="row"><button class="goldbutton" data-action="ownerToggle">${state.owner?'Disable owner demo':'Enable owner demo'}</button><button class="softbutton" data-action="fullscreen">Full Screen</button></div><p class="notice">This toggle is not secure. A real commercial release must authenticate an owner's account on a server and enforce purchases server-side.</p><p>Progress saves in this browser's local storage. No server, multiplayer, or real payments are connected.</p><button class="ghostbutton" data-action="resetConfirm">Reset Save (confirmation)</button>`)}
function resetConfirm(){modal(`<h2>Reset local progress?</h2><p>This will delete this browser's saved roster, chapters, items, and quests. It cannot be undone.</p><div class="row"><button class="redbutton" data-action="reset">Reset my game</button><button class="ghostbutton" data-action="close">Cancel</button></div>`)}
function act(a,id){switch(a){case'tab':close();changeTab(id);break;case'close':close();break;case'shop':close();changeTab('shop');break;case'preview':preview(id);break;case'getHero':getHero(id);break;case'confirmAdult':state.adultConfirmed=true;save();close();if(pendingHero)getHero(pendingHero);pendingHero=null;break;case'tryHero':beginBattle('preview',id);break;case'party':party(id);break;case'train':train(id);break;case'summon':summon();break;case'buyPass':buyPass(id);break;case'buyPack':buyPack(Number(id));break;case'buyGear':buyGear(id);break;case'claim':questsClaim(id);break;case'chooseChapter':chooseChapter(Number(id));break;case'battle':beginBattle(id);break;case'cast':cast(Number(id));break;case'battleAuto':if(!access()){toast('Full Auto unlocks with Weekly or Monthly Pass');changeTab('passes');return}battle.auto=!battle.auto;renderBattle();break;case'speed':if(!access()){toast('2× speed requires a pass');return}battle.speed=battle.speed===1?2:1;renderBattle();break;case'retreat':battle=null;changeTab('home');toast('You left the battle');break;case'afterBattle':{const back=battle?.mode==='boss'?'boss':battle?.mode==='arena'?'arena':battle?.mode==='guild'?'guild':battle?.mode==='preview'?'heroes':'campaign';battle=null;close();changeTab(back);break;}case'settings':settings();break;case'ownerToggle':state.owner=!state.owner;save();render();settings();break;case'fullscreen':close();try{document.documentElement.requestFullscreen?.()}catch(e){}break;case'resetConfirm':resetConfirm();break;case'reset':state=fresh();save();close();changeTab('home');toast('Local save reset');break;}}
document.addEventListener('click',ev=>{const el=ev.target.closest('[data-action]');if(!el)return;const a=el.dataset.action;act(a,el.dataset.id||'')});window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(tab==='battle')resizeCanvas()});document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)last=performance.now()});
render();

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
